_about: Grid row order per sport (rendering contract §2). Rows render top-to-bottom: broadcast, cable, conference, then streaming groups. `station`/`channel` are the viewer's local over-the-air affiliates (Cleveland DMA) and render as call letters above the network mark in the rail. Rows with no eligible game are omitted at render time. Edit here; the renderer reads this file directly. Pro leagues (v1.5): `local` rows are the market team's local feed; when the carrier is unannounced the adapter synthesizes a local row and the rail prints the local_row_label from data/render_policies.json.

broadcast._note: the Cavaliers' OTA simulcast puts 13 of 15 games on WOIO (announced 2026-09-15; data/local_rights.json nba.CLE.simulcasts). station/channel ARE carried here, unlike the WUAB 43 entry below: the call-letters band is drawn from these keys, and the CBS mark does not carry the call letters the Cleveland's 43 art does. Placed after the national broadcasters and before WUAB 43, which is the station order WOIO 19 -> WUAB 43 this file's _ordering_note sets.
no station/channel keys on purpose: the Cleveland's 43 mark identifies the station, so the call-letters band is suppressed (Joe, 2026-09-01)

_ordering_note: Station ordering rule (Joe, 2026-09-01): when WOIO 19, WUAB 43 and The CW/WBNX 55 share a grid, the order is WOIO 19 -> WUAB 43 -> WBNX 55 (channel order). The OTA Cavs simulcasts are split across BOTH stations (decision 7, schedule announced 2026-09-15): nine of the fifteen are WOIO only, two are WUAB 43 only, and four are on both - see data/local_rights.json nba.CLE.simulcasts, where the outlet is per game.
